doctrines.note: Veterancy: Full Bot -- "Nerfs guided this unit toward the Tank Line over the DPS one." Hero pairing: Any. "CCi may be important after the nerf since you need to reposition WAY more often (the +40% dmg in the back should scare you). If you don't need the leadership doctrine, take more tank or dmg like Unit Damage Doctrine V or Steadfast Doctrine V." Example build per OP: Epic Spear Doctrine VI (CCi) / Steadfast Doctrine V (+130 def, -6% dmg taken), Awareness Doctrine V (20% rear atk reduction, -500 cav dmg), Block Doctrine V (+300 block, -90 flat dmg taken), Unit Damage Doctrine V / Spartan Chosen: Mountain Crusher (Spartan Vengeance +15% block-break & dmg), Epic Leadership Doctrine. Alt build per OP: Top line + Unit Damage Doctrine if you really know what you're doing and want more stats -- "Not recommended. If you're confident enough to try it, you don't need a guide." Tutorial video follow-up post (2025-02-09) links a YouTube embed by creator Akers, not transcribed (read-only capture; embed caption/thumbnail only). Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset -- Spartan Chosen is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).

entries.text: Huge burst DMG such as Iron Reapers or Claymores or Orochi.
Any units with high minimum DMG.
Big braced blob -- "you will open for your team to push-in."

steps.text: Same as the grandpa one -- redirects them to where you're facing and stabs in front. Each stab heals 5% HP.
Similar to an Imperial Pikes Advance, but you have to re-press 2 during the advance to stab with your shield. At the 3rd press 2 (end of it), your unit jumps forward and stabs for big damage.
For 5s after using a spell, every damage taken is spread through the whole unit (and reduced to 70%, so 30% dmg reduction).
Play around your cooldowns -- never hesitate to redirect and replace yourself before pressing 2, also don't hesitate to activate CCi and X-move back if going too deep.
